_comment: Reinforcement insertion by ranks (depth axis doubling, #1574). Two 40-man player Infantry units stand in column: host at (520, 560) facing down, reserve at (520, 390) in the rear. The player selects the reserve, presses Ctrl+Shift+M to arm insertion by ranks, and right-clicks the host. The reserve marches to the rendezvous behind the host (maneuver REINFORCING); upon arrival, each reserve rank steps into the host between existing ranks, doubling depth from 5 to 10 ranks while holding frontage at 9 files. Formation anchor shifts rearward so the front rank holds its ground.
